guesses.reason: Cream/yellow short dense coat, broad head, black nose, friendly open-mouthed expression, and otter-like tail suggest Yellow Lab ancestry.
Creamy white coat with lighter body, somewhat foxy face shape, and medium athletic build are typical of Jindo-type mixes often seen in rescue.

breed.appearance: A young, medium-to-large puppy with a short, dense creamy-white coat that warms to pale buttery tan on the ears, top of the head, and tail. Her ears are soft, semi-floppy and fold outward at the tips like little wings, framing a broad face with dark brown almond eyes, a large black nose, black lips, and a happy open-mouthed grin showing a pink tongue. She sits upright with a deep white chest, sturdy straight legs, and big oversized white paws, wearing a thin teal collar.
breed.fun_fact: Labrador Retrievers have been America's favorite family dog for decades thanks to their sunny, people-loving personalities!
